title: Dolmen

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Dolmens are Points of interest found in the Meadows and the Black Forest. Dolmens consist of two or more upright megaliths supporting a large flat horizontal capstone.
For similar structures found in Plains, see Stonehenge.

sections.heading: Resources
sections.text:
They come in three variants. Each have a chance for the following feature:
• A 50% chance for a Skeleton spawning at night once.
• Bone remains, which can be picked for one Bone fragments.
• A valuable among 1–4 Ambers, 2–14 Coins or 1–2 Amber pearls.
